versions.content: On invocation of EthTSyn_RxIndication for the Sync message and if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport is set to TRUE and if the StbM does use the Ethernet hardware counter as Virtual Local Time Source for the Time Base: • The T2 V LT part of the Rx Time Tuple shall be set to the value of T1 V LT (i.e., T2 V LT = T1 V LT ) • The Sync reception delay T SRD shall be set to 0
